source.text: שִׁמְע֞וּ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה פָּר֤וֹת הַבָּשָׁן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן הָעֹשְׁק֣וֹת דַּלִּ֔ים הָרֹצְצ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים הָאֹמְרֹ֥ת לַאֲדֹֽנֵיהֶ֖ם הָבִ֥יאָה וְנִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear this word, cows of the Bashan who [are] on [the] mountain of Samaria, who oppress [the] poor, who crush [the] needy, who say to their lords: Bring, and let us drink.

en.L: Hear this word, cows of Bashan, you who [are] on the mount of Samaria, \q you who oppress the poor, \q who crush the needy, \q who say to their lords, "Bring, and let us drink!"
en.B: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on the hill of Samaria, \q you who oppress the poor \q and crush the needy, \q who say to their husbands, "Bring us something to drink!"
en.R: Listen to this message, you women of Samaria, as fat as the cows of Bashan. \q You mistreat poor people \q and crush those in need. \q You say to your husbands, "Bring us more to drink!"

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} esta palabra, vacas de Basán, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}} que {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en el monte de Samaria, \q que {{plural_you:oprimen|oprimís}} a los pobres, \q que {{plural_you:aplastan|aplastáis}} a los necesitados, \q que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} a sus señores: «¡Trae, y bebamos!».
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} esta palabra, vacas de Basán que {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en el monte de Samaria, \q {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}} que {{plural_you:oprimen|oprimís}} a los pobres \q y {{plural_you:aplastan|aplastáis}} a los necesitados, \q que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} a sus maridos: «¡Tráenos algo de beber!».
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} este mensaje, mujeres de Samaria, gordas como las vacas de Basán. \q {{plural_you:Maltratan|Maltratáis}} a los pobres \q y {{plural_you:aplastan|aplastáis}} a los necesitados. \q Les {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} a {{plural_you:sus maridos|vuestros maridos}}: «¡Tráenos más de beber!».

fr.L: Écoutez cette parole, vaches du Bashân, vous qui [êtes] sur la montagne de Samarie, \q vous qui opprimez les pauvres, \q qui écrasez les indigents, \q qui dites à leurs maîtres : « Apporte, et buvons ! »
fr.B: Écoutez cette parole, vaches du Bashân, sur la colline de Samarie, \q vous qui opprimez les pauvres \q et écrasez les indigents, \q qui dites à vos maris : « Apportez-nous à boire ! »
fr.R: Écoutez ce message, femmes de Samarie, grasses comme les vaches du Bashân. \q Vous maltraitez les pauvres \q et vous écrasez ceux qui sont dans le besoin. \q Vous dites à vos maris : « Apportez-nous encore à boire ! »

sw.L: Sikieni neno hili, enyi ng'ombe wa Bashani, mlio juu ya mlima wa Samaria, \q ninyi mnaowaonea maskini, \q mnaowaponda wahitaji, \q mnaowaambia mabwana zenu, "Leteni, tunywe!"
sw.B: Sikilizeni neno hili, enyi ng'ombe wa Bashani mlio juu ya kilima cha Samaria, \q ninyi mnaowaonea maskini \q na kuwaponda wahitaji, \q mnaowaambia waume zenu, "Tuleteeni kitu cha kunywa!"
sw.R: Sikilizeni ujumbe huu, enyi wanawake wa Samaria mlionona kama ng'ombe wa Bashani. \q Mnawatendea maskini mabaya \q na kuwaponda wahitaji. \q Mnawaambia waume zenu, "Tuleteeni vinywaji zaidi!"

vi.L: Hãy nghe lời này, hỡi những con bò cái của Ba-san, các ngươi là những kẻ ở trên núi Sa-ma-ri, \q các ngươi là những kẻ áp bức người nghèo, \q chà đạp người túng thiếu, \q và nói với các chủ của mình: "Hãy đem đến, cho chúng ta uống!"
vi.B: Hãy nghe lời này, hỡi những con bò cái Ba-san trên đồi Sa-ma-ri, \q các ngươi là những kẻ áp bức người nghèo \q và chà đạp người túng thiếu, \q là những kẻ nói với chồng mình: "Đem rượu đến cho chúng tôi uống!"
vi.R: Hãy nghe sứ điệp này, hỡi các bà ở Sa-ma-ri, béo tốt như những con bò cái Ba-san. \q Các ngươi ngược đãi người nghèo \q và chà đạp những người túng thiếu. \q Các ngươi bảo chồng mình: "Đem thêm rượu đến cho chúng tôi uống!"

ko.L: 사마리아 산에 있는 바산의 암소들아, 이 말을 들어라. \q 가난한 자들을 억압하고, \q 궁핍한 자들을 짓밟으며, \q 자기 주인들에게 "가져오너라, 우리가 마시자!" 하고 말하는 자들아.
ko.B: 사마리아 언덕에 사는 바산의 암소들아, 이 말을 들어라. \q 너희는 가난한 사람들을 억압하고 \q 궁핍한 사람들을 짓밟으며, \q 남편들에게 "마실 것을 가져와요!" 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 바산의 암소들처럼 살진 사마리아의 여자들아, 이 말을 들어라. \q 너희는 가난한 사람들을 괴롭히고 \q 어려운 사람들을 짓밟는다. \q 너희는 남편들에게 "술을 더 가져와요!" 하고 말한다.

pt.L: Ouçam esta palavra, vacas de Basã, vocês que [estão] no monte de Samaria, \q vocês que oprimem os pobres, \q que esmagam os necessitados, \q que dizem aos seus senhores: "Tragam, e bebamos!"
pt.B: Ouçam esta palavra, vacas de Basã, vocês que estão no monte de Samaria, \q que oprimem os pobres \q e esmagam os necessitados, \q que dizem aos seus maridos: "Tragam bebida para nós!"
pt.R: Escutem esta mensagem, mulheres de Samaria, gordas como as vacas de Basã! \q Vocês maltratam os pobres \q e esmagam os necessitados. \q Vocês dizem aos seus maridos: "Tragam mais bebida para nós!"

am.L: እናንተ በሰማርያ ተራራ ላይ ያላችሁ የባሳን ላሞች፣ ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤ \q ድሆችን የምትጨቁኑ፣ \q ምስኪኖችን የምታደቅቁ፣ \q ጌቶቻቸውንም፦ «አምጡ፤ እንጠጣ!» የምትሉ።
am.B: በሰማርያ ኮረብታ ላይ ያላችሁ እናንተ የባሳን ላሞች፣ ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤ \q ድሆችን የምትጨቁኑ፣ \q ምስኪኖችንም የምታደቅቁ፣ \q ባሎቻችሁንም፦ «የምንጠጣውን አምጡልን!» የምትሉ።
am.R: እናንተ እንደ ባሳን ላሞች የሰባችሁ የሰማርያ ሴቶች፣ ይህን መልእክት ስሙ። \q ድሆችን ትበድላላችሁ፤ \q የተቸገሩትንም ታደቅቃላችሁ። \q ባሎቻችሁንም፦ «ተጨማሪ መጠጥ አምጡልን!» ትላላችሁ።

hi.L: हे बाशान की गायो, तुम जो सामरिया के पर्वत पर [हो], यह वचन सुनो, \q तुम जो कंगालों पर अंधेर करती हो, \q जो दरिद्रों को कुचलती हो, \q जो अपने स्वामियों से कहती हो, "ले आओ, कि हम पिएँ!"
hi.B: हे सामरिया की पहाड़ी पर रहनेवाली बाशान की गायो, यह वचन सुनो, \q तुम जो कंगालों पर अंधेर करती हो \q और दरिद्रों को कुचलती हो, \q जो अपने पतियों से कहती हो, "हमारे पीने के लिए कुछ लाओ!"
hi.R: हे सामरिया की स्त्रियो, तुम जो बाशान की गायों जैसी मोटी हो, यह संदेश सुनो। \q तुम ग़रीबों के साथ बुरा व्यवहार करती हो \q और ज़रूरतमंदों को कुचलती हो। \q तुम अपने पतियों से कहती हो, "हमारे लिए और पीने को लाओ!"

ru.L: Слушайте это слово, коровы Васана, что на горе Самарии, \q угнетающие бедных, \q давящие нищих, \q говорящие своим господам: «Подай, и будем пить!»
ru.B: Слушайте это слово, коровы Васана на холме Самарии, \q вы, что угнетаете бедных \q и давите нищих, \q что говорите своим мужьям: «Принеси нам выпить!»
ru.R: Послушайте эту весть, женщины Самарии, раскормленные, как коровы Васана! \q Вы обижаете бедных людей \q и давите нуждающихся. \q Вы говорите своим мужьям: «Принеси нам ещё выпить!»

ja.L: この言葉を聞け、サマリアの山にいるバシャンの雌牛たちよ。 \q 弱い者たちを虐げ、 \q 貧しい者たちを押しつぶし、 \q 自分たちの主人に「持って来て。飲もう！」と言う者たちよ。
ja.B: サマリアの丘にいるバシャンの雌牛たちよ、この言葉を聞きなさい。 \q 弱い者たちを虐げ、 \q 貧しい者たちを押しつぶし、 \q 夫たちに「飲み物を持って来て！」と言う者たちよ。
ja.R: バシャンの牛のように太ったサマリアの女たちよ、この言葉を聞きなさい。 \q あなたたちは、貧しい人々をひどい目にあわせ、 \q 困っている人々を押しつぶしている。 \q そして、夫たちに「もっと飲み物を持って来て！」と言う。

decisions.choice: cows of Bashan: the sleek, well-fed cattle of the richest grazing land
decisions.reason: Bashan was the high plateau east of the Sea of Galilee, famous for its rich pasture and its strong, well-fed cattle (Deuteronomy 32:14; Psalm 22:13; Ezekiel 39:18). To call people "cows of Bashan" pictures them as pampered and fat on the best of everything, while they live off the poor. Verses 2-3 show where such cattle end up: led away through the breaches.

decisions.choice: the cows are the wealthy women of Samaria
alternatives: the rich rulers of Samaria, men and women
decisions.reason: The participles "who oppress", "who crush" and "who say" are feminine, and in verse 3 "each woman" goes out through the breaches. They speak to "their lords", their husbands. So the words are addressed to the rich women of the capital. Some pronouns in verses 1-3 are masculine ("their lords", "upon you" in verse 2), a mixing found elsewhere in Hebrew, and some take the "cows" more widely, as the rich and powerful of Samaria, men and women alike.

decisions.choice: their lords: their husbands
decisions.reason: A wife could call her husband "my lord" (Genesis 18:12; Judges 19:26-27). The word also hints at the irony: the women give the orders, and their "lords" obey.

decisions.choice: oppress the poor ... "Bring, and let us drink!": their drinking is paid for by the poor
decisions.reason: The women may not oppress the poor with their own hands, but their demands for wine drive their husbands to squeeze the poor for it. The same pair, "the poor" and "the needy", stands in 2:6-7 and 8:4-6.

decisions.choice: you women of Samaria, as fat as the cows of Bashan (R); husbands (B, R); lords (L)
decisions.reason: Readable says who the "cows" are and what the picture means, following m2. Since m2 is uncertain, so is this wording. Balanced and Readable say "husbands" for "lords" (m3); Readable says "your husbands" because it speaks to the women directly throughout.

decisions.choice: plural_you in the feminine ("ustedes" / "vosotras") for the women of Samaria
decisions.reason: The rich women are addressed as a group, so every "you" in 4:1-3 is a plural_you span whose vosotros option is feminine ("vosotras", "arrastradas"), as 1 Peter 3:1-5 in Spanish. The Hebrew "their lords" switches to the third person; L and B keep it ("sus señores", "sus maridos"), R says "your" as the English does.

decisions.choice: "sus señores" (L); "sus maridos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Adon of a husband is kept word for word at L; B and R say who is meant.

decisions.choice: "vaches du Bashân" with feminine "vous" (L, B); "femmes de Samarie, grasses comme les vaches du Bashân" (R); "leurs maîtres" (L), "vos maris" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The rich women of Samaria are addressed as a group, in the second person plural, and Literal keeps the Hebrew's switch to "their lords"; Bashan keeps the form of the published French ("le Bashân"). The cry "Bring" is singular in Hebrew, said to each husband, so Literal has "Apporte".

decisions.choice: "mabwana zenu" (L); "waume zenu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "their lords"; the Swahili uses "zenu" (your) because the women are addressed directly, which Swahili prefers to a switch from "you" to "their" within the sentence.

decisions.choice: "những con bò cái của Ba-san" (L, B); "các bà ở Sa-ma-ri, béo tốt như những con bò cái Ba-san" (R)
decisions.reason: The cows are the rich women of Samaria (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep Amos's picture with "bò cái", and Readable names the women, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "các chủ của mình" (L); "chồng mình" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Their "lords" are their husbands (meaning decision); Literal keeps "chủ", lowercase, and the others say "chồng".

decisions.choice: The women's words to their husbands are 해요체 ("가져와요") at B and R; L keeps the Hebrew "주인들" with plain 해라체
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives 해요체 for husband and wife (Genesis note, Hosea 3); the demand is a wife's to her husband, while Literal keeps the Hebrew "lords".

decisions.choice: as vacas de Basã (L, B); mulheres de Samaria, gordas como as vacas de Basã (R)
decisions.reason: "Vacas de Basã" keeps the picture (m1); the Portuguese feminine "vacas" already fits the women addressed (m2). Readable says who they are, as the English does, and like it is only as certain as m2. They are addressed as "vocês", a group of people.

decisions.choice: os seus senhores (L); os seus maridos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "senhores"; Balanced and Readable say "maridos" (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English spans on the LORD's pronouns in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: cows of Bashan "የባሳን ላሞች"; their lords "ጌቶቻቸው" (L), "ባሎቻችሁ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Bashan keeps the form used in Chronicles. Literal keeps the Hebrew "their lords", which turns from the women to the third person; Balanced and Readable say husbands and keep the second person, as the English levels do. Readable says outright that the cows are the women of Samaria, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: feminine forms for the "cows" (करती हो, जाओगी); स्वामी (L), पति (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cows of Bashan are the wealthy women of Samaria (meaning decision m2), so Hindi uses feminine verbs through verses 1-3, as the Hebrew does; Readable names them, as the English Readable does, and that reading is as uncertain as m2. "Their lords" are their husbands (m3).

decisions.choice: коровы Васана
decisions.reason: The cows are the wealthy women of Samaria (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, and Readable names the women, as the English. Bashan as Deuteronomy (Васан).

decisions.choice: своим господам (L); своим мужьям (B, R)
decisions.reason: Their lords are their husbands (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew word, as the English.

decisions.choice: parot habbashan "バシャンの雌牛たち" (L, B), R "バシャンの牛のように太ったサマリアの女たち" as the English R; 'adoneihem "主人" (L), "夫たち" (B, R); the women addressed "あなたたち" (R), not おまえたち.
decisions.reason: They are Israel's own people (ISA address rule); m2 identifies them as Samaria's wealthy women.

source.text: נִשְׁבַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ בְּקָדְשׁ֔וֹ כִּ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה יָמִ֖ים בָּאִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְנִשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ בְּצִנּ֔וֹת וְאַחֲרִיתְכֶ֖ן בְּסִיר֥וֹת דּוּגָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Has sworn [the] Lord Yahweh by his holiness: For look, days [are] coming upon you, and one will lift you away with hooks, and your remnant with fishhooks.

en.L: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness: \q Look, days are coming upon you \q when they will carry you away with hooks, \q and the last of you with fishhooks.
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness: \q The time is surely coming for you \q when you will be dragged away with hooks, \q the last of you with fishhooks.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} has made a solemn promise by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own holiness: \q The time is coming for you \q when your enemies will drag you away with hooks, \q every last one of you, like fish on hooks.

es.L: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad: \q He aquí, vienen días sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}} \q en que {{plural_you:las|os}} llevarán con garfios, \q y a {{plural_you:las últimas de ustedes|vuestras últimas}} con anzuelos de pesca.
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad: \q Ciertamente viene el tiempo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}} \q en que {{plural_you:serán arrastradas|seréis arrastradas}} con garfios, \q y hasta la última con anzuelos.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} ha hecho un juramento solemne por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia santidad: \q Viene el tiempo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}} \q en que {{plural_you:sus enemigos las|vuestros enemigos os}} arrastrarán con garfios, \q hasta la última, como peces en el anzuelo.

fr.L: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} l’a juré par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté : \q Voici, des jours viennent sur vous \q où l’on vous enlèvera avec des crocs, \q et les dernières d’entre vous avec des hameçons.
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} l’a juré par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté : \q Le temps vient pour vous, c’est certain, \q où vous serez traînées au loin avec des crocs, \q et les dernières d’entre vous avec des hameçons.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} l’a promis solennellement par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre sainteté : \q Le temps vient pour vous \q où vos ennemis vous traîneront au loin avec des crocs, \q toutes, jusqu’à la dernière, comme des poissons au bout d’un hameçon.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ameapa kwa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}: \q Tazama, siku zinawajia \q watakapowachukua kwa kulabu, \q na wale wa mwisho wenu kwa ndoana.
sw.B: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ameapa kwa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}: \q Hakika wakati unawajia \q mtakapoburutwa kwa kulabu, \q wa mwisho wenu kwa ndoana.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ameahidi kwa kiapo kwa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}: \q Wakati unawajia \q adui zenu watakapowaburuta kwa kulabu, \q kila mmoja wenu hadi wa mwisho, kama samaki kwenye ndoana.

vi.L: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chỉ sự thánh khiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q Này, những ngày sắp đến trên các ngươi, \q khi người ta sẽ dùng móc mà kéo các ngươi đi, \q và những kẻ sót lại của các ngươi bằng lưỡi câu.
vi.B: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chỉ sự thánh khiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q Chắc chắn thời kỳ đang đến cho các ngươi, \q khi các ngươi sẽ bị kéo đi bằng móc sắt, \q người cuối cùng của các ngươi bằng lưỡi câu.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lấy chính sự thánh khiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà hứa long trọng: \q Thời kỳ đang đến cho các ngươi, \q khi kẻ thù sẽ dùng móc kéo các ngươi đi, \q đến người cuối cùng, như cá mắc lưỡi câu.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 그분의 거룩하심을 두고 맹세하셨다. \q 보라, 날들이 너희에게 오고 있다. \q 그때에 그들이 너희를 갈고리로 끌어가고, \q 너희 가운데 남은 자들을 낚싯바늘로 [끌어갈 것이다].
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 그분의 거룩하심을 두고 맹세하셨다. \q 너희에게 반드시 그때가 온다. \q 너희가 갈고리에 꿰여 끌려가고, \q 너희 가운데 마지막 사람까지 낚싯바늘에 꿰여 끌려갈 것이다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 그분의 거룩하심을 걸고 엄숙하게 약속하셨다. \q 너희에게 그때가 오고 있다. \q 그때에 원수들이 너희를 갈고리로 끌고 갈 것이다. \q 너희는 한 사람도 남김없이 낚싯바늘에 걸린 물고기처럼 끌려갈 것이다.

pt.L: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} jurou pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade: \q Eis que vêm dias sobre vocês \q em que as levarão com ganchos, \q e o resto de vocês com anzóis.
pt.B: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} jurou pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade: \q Certamente vem o tempo para vocês \q em que serão arrastadas com ganchos, \q e as últimas de vocês, com anzóis.
pt.R: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} fez um juramento solene pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria santidade: \q Está chegando o tempo para vocês \q em que os seus inimigos vão arrastar vocês com ganchos, \q cada uma de vocês, como peixes presos em anzóis.

am.L: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በቅድስናው ምሏል፦ \q እነሆ፣ ቀኖች በእናንተ ላይ ይመጣሉ፤ \q በመንጠቆ ይወስዷችኋል፤ \q ቅሬታችሁንም በዓሣ መንጠቆ።
am.B: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በቅድስናው ምሏል፦ \q ጊዜው በእርግጥ ይመጣባችኋል፤ \q በመንጠቆ ተጎትታችሁ ትወሰዳላችሁ፤ \q የቀራችሁትም በዓሣ መንጠቆ።
am.R: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በገዛ ቅድስናው ጽኑ መሐላ ማለ፦ \q ጊዜው ይመጣባችኋል፤ \q ጠላቶቻችሁ በመንጠቆ ጎትተው ይወስዷችኋል፤ \q እስከ መጨረሻው ሰው ድረስ እንደ ዓሣ በመንጠቆ ትያዛላችሁ።

hi.L: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} ने अपनी पवित्रता की शपथ खाई है: \q देखो, तुम पर ऐसे दिन आ रहे हैं \q जब वे तुम्हें काँटों से उठा ले जाएँगे, \q और तुम में से बची हुइयों को मछली के काँटों से।
hi.B: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} ने अपनी पवित्रता की शपथ खाई है: \q निश्चय तुम पर वह समय आ रहा है \q जब तुम काँटों से घसीटकर ले जाई जाओगी, \q और तुम में से आख़िरी भी मछली के काँटों से।
hi.R: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} ने अपनी पवित्रता की गंभीर शपथ खाई है: \q तुम पर वह समय आ रहा है \q जब तुम्हारे शत्रु तुम्हें काँटों से घसीटकर ले जाएँगे, \q तुम में से एक-एक को, जैसे काँटे में फँसी मछलियों को।

ru.L: Поклялся Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} своей святостью: \q Вот, приходят на вас дни, \q когда унесут вас крюками \q и остаток ваш — рыболовными крючками.
ru.B: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поклялся своей святостью: \q Непременно настанет для вас время, \q когда вас потащат крюками, \q а последних из вас — рыболовными крючками.
ru.R: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал торжественную клятву своей святостью: \q Настанет для вас время, \q когда враги потащат вас крюками, \q всех до последней, как рыбу на крючках.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はご自分の聖にかけて誓われた。 \q 見なさい、日々があなたがたの上に来る。 \q 人々があなたがたを鉤で引き上げ、 \q あなたがたの残りの者を釣り針で[引き上げる日々が]。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の聖なることにかけて誓われた。 \q まことに、あなたがたに時が来る。 \q あなたがたは鉤で引いて行かれ、 \q 残った者も釣り針で引かれて行く。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の聖さにかけて、固く約束された。 \q あなたたちに、その時が来る。 \q 敵があなたたちを鉤で引いて行く。 \q 最後の一人まで、釣り針にかかった魚のように。

decisions.choice: sworn by his holiness: the LORD swears by what he is, so the oath cannot fail
decisions.reason: People swear by something greater than themselves; the LORD can swear only by himself (6:8), by his holiness (Psalm 89:36), or by what he has made his own (8:7). His holiness stands against the profaning of his name (2:7). It is the surest of oaths.

decisions.choice: days are coming: the time is coming
decisions.reason: The phrase announces a coming time of judgment or of restoration (8:11; 9:13; Jeremiah 7:32).

decisions.choice: hooks ... fishhooks: the captives are dragged away like fish on hooks
alternatives: carried away in baskets, the last of you in fish pots
decisions.reason: Both words are rare. They are usually taken as hooks or barbs, the second as fishing hooks, and conquerors are pictured leading captives with hooks (2 Kings 19:28; Ezekiel 19:4; 29:4). The words can also mean thorns and pots, so that the people are carried off in baskets as fish were. "The last of you" may also be "your descendants". On every reading, the cows of Bashan are taken away like animals or fish.

decisions.choice: they will carry you away: the enemy, not named
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject ("one will lift you away"), as Hebrew does when the doer does not matter. It is the enemy of 3:11.

decisions.choice: The time is surely coming (B); has made a solemn promise; your enemies; like fish on hooks (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "days are coming" (m2). Readable explains the oath and names the enemy as the doer (m4).

decisions.choice: Eis que vêm dias (L); Certamente vem o tempo (B); Está chegando o tempo (R); feminine forms
decisions.reason: "Eis que vêm dias" is the prophets' formula at Literal, as Isaiah and Jeremiah have it in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m2). The words are still spoken to the women of verse 1, so Portuguese uses feminine forms ("as levarão", "arrastadas", "as últimas", "cada uma").

decisions.choice: days are coming: "እነሆ፣ ቀኖች ይመጣሉ" (L), "ጊዜው ይመጣል" (B, R here; B "ቀኖች ይመጣሉ" in 8:11 and 9:13, where the English B says "The days are coming")
decisions.reason: The formula keeps Jeremiah's wording (Jeremiah 30:3; 49:2); Balanced and Readable follow their English level each time.

decisions.choice: Вот, приходят дни (L); Непременно настанет время (B); Настанет время (R)
decisions.reason: "Days are coming" means the time is coming (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Prophets' idiom, the others say time, as the English.

decisions.choice: nishba' beqodsho "ご自分の聖にかけて誓われた" (L), "聖なることにかけて" (B), "聖さにかけて、固く約束された" (R); hinneh yamim ba'im "見なさい、日々が…来る" (L), "まことに、…時が来る" (B), "その時が来る" (R).
decisions.reason: The hinneh rule (見なさい at L, never 見よ); B and R by the English B and R.

source.text: וּפְרָצִ֥ים תֵּצֶ֖אנָה אִשָּׁ֣ה נֶגְדָּ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּ֥נָה הַהַרְמ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And through breaches you will go out, each woman before her, and you will be cast toward the Harmon, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And through the breaches you will go out, each [woman] straight ahead, \q and you will be cast out toward Harmon, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You will go out through the breaches in the wall, each one straight ahead, \q and you will be thrown out toward Harmon, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will go out through the holes in the broken walls, each of you straight ahead, \q and you will be thrown out toward Harmon, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y por las brechas {{plural_you:saldrán|saldréis}}, cada [una] derecho delante de sí, \q y {{plural_you:serán arrojadas|seréis arrojadas}} hacia Harmón, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saldrán|Saldréis}} por las brechas de la muralla, cada una derecho delante de sí, \q y {{plural_you:serán arrojadas|seréis arrojadas}} hacia Harmón, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saldrán|Saldréis}} por los huecos de las murallas derribadas, una detrás de otra, \q y {{plural_you:serán arrojadas|seréis arrojadas}} hacia Harmón, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et par les brèches vous sortirez, chacune droit devant elle, \q et vous serez jetées vers Harmôn, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous sortirez par les brèches de la muraille, chacune droit devant elle, \q et vous serez jetées vers Harmôn, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous sortirez par les trous des murailles écroulées, chacune droit devant elle, \q et vous serez jetées dehors, vers Harmôn, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nanyi mtatoka kupitia mahali palipobomoka, kila [mwanamke] moja kwa moja mbele yake, \q nanyi mtatupwa kuelekea Harmoni, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtatoka kupitia mahali palipobomoka ukutani, kila mmoja moja kwa moja mbele yake, \q nanyi mtatupwa nje kuelekea Harmoni, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mtatoka kupitia mapengo ya kuta zilizobomoka, kila mmoja wenu moja kwa moja mbele yake, \q nanyi mtatupwa nje kuelekea Harmoni, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và qua những chỗ tường thủng các ngươi sẽ đi ra, mỗi [người đàn bà] đi thẳng trước mặt mình, \q và các ngươi sẽ bị ném về phía Hạt-môn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ đi ra qua những lỗ thủng trên tường thành, người nào cũng đi thẳng phía trước, \q và các ngươi sẽ bị ném ra về phía Hạt-môn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ đi ra qua những lỗ hổng nơi tường thành đổ nát, ai nấy đi thẳng phía trước, \q và các ngươi sẽ bị ném ra về phía Hạt-môn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 너희는 무너진 틈으로 나가되, 각자 [자기] 앞으로 [나갈 것이다]. \q 그리고 너희는 하르몬 쪽으로 내던져질 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 너희는 성벽의 무너진 틈으로 한 사람씩 곧장 끌려 나가, \q 하르몬 쪽으로 내던져질 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 너희는 무너진 성벽의 구멍으로 한 사람씩 끌려 나갈 것이다. \q 그리고 하르몬 쪽으로 내던져질 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E pelas brechas sairão, cada uma em frente, \q e serão lançadas para Harmom, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Vocês sairão pelas brechas do muro, cada uma em frente, \q e serão lançadas para Harmom, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vocês vão sair pelos buracos dos muros derrubados, uma atrás da outra, \q e vão ser jogadas para os lados de Harmom, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: በክፍተቶቹም በኩል ትወጣላችሁ፤ እያንዳንዷ [ሴት] ፊት ለፊት፤ \q ወደ ሐርሞንም ትጣላላችሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: በቅጥሩ ክፍተቶች በኩል ትወጣላችሁ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁ በቀጥታ ወደ ፊት፤ \q ወደ ሐርሞንም ትጣላላችሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: በፈረሱት ቅጥሮች ቀዳዳ በኩል እያንዳንዳችሁ ቀጥ ብላችሁ ትወጣላችሁ፤ \q ወደ ሐርሞንም ትጣላላችሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और तुम दरारों में से निकलोगी, हर एक [स्त्री] सीधे अपने आगे, \q और तुम हरमोन की ओर फेंकी जाओगी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: तुम शहरपनाह की दरारों में से निकलोगी, हर एक सीधे अपने आगे, \q और हरमोन की ओर फेंक दी जाओगी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: तुम टूटी दीवारों के छेदों में से निकलोगी, हर एक सीधे आगे, \q और हरमोन की ओर फेंक दी जाओगी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И через проломы выйдете, каждая прямо перед собой, \q и будете брошены к Хармону, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Вы выйдете через проломы в стене, каждая прямо перед собой, \q и будете выброшены к Хармону, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Вы выйдете через дыры в разрушенных стенах, одна за другой, \q и вас выбросят к Хармону, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: あなたがたは破れ口から出て行く。[女たちは]それぞれ自分の前へ。 \q そして、ハルモンへ投げ出される。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: あなたがたは城壁の破れ口から、それぞれまっすぐ前へ出て行き、 \q ハルモンへ投げ出される、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: あなたたちは、崩れた城壁の穴から、一人ずつまっすぐに出て行き、 \q ハルモンへ投げ出される、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: through the breaches ... each straight ahead: led out through the gaps in the broken walls, one behind another
decisions.reason: When a city fell, its walls were breached and its people led out through the gaps. "Each straight ahead" pictures them going in file, unable to turn aside, like cattle driven through a broken fence (compare Joshua 6:5, 20).

decisions.choice: you will be cast out: reading the verb as passive
decisions.reason: The Hebrew vowels give an active verb, "you will cast out", with no object, which is hard to make sense of. The same letters read with other vowels give "you will be cast out", and several ancient translations take it that way. That reading is followed here.

decisions.choice: Harmon: a place not otherwise known
decisions.reason: Harmon is named nowhere else, and its location is unknown. Some take it as Mount Hermon in the far north, on the road to exile, or read it with the ancient translations as another name; it may also be a word for a place of refuse. It is clearly the place where the captives are thrown.

decisions.choice: in the wall (B), in the broken walls (R); each one (B)

en.B: Go to Bethel and rebel! \q Go to Gilgal and rebel even more! \q Bring your sacrifices every morning, \q your tithes every three days!

am.L: ወደ ቤቴል ኑ፤ ተላለፉም፤ \q ወደ ጌልገላ [ኑ]፤ መተላለፍንም አብዙ፤ \q በየማለዳውም መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ \q በየሦስቱ ቀንም አሥራታችሁን አምጡ፤
